# MapleMoon masked founder grade report

## Method and scope

This is a deterministic RGB-only grade. No generative model, fill, retouching, smoothing, geometry change, mask edit, identity edit, reconstruction, or reshaping was used. The original alpha plane was copied byte-for-byte into each trimmed full-resolution master.

The documented 19 Aug transform family was reused: one fitted 3x3 RGB colour matrix followed by a 256-entry monotone LUT for each output channel. Its old coefficients were not reused because they were fitted to a different paired RAW/output crop. Each supplied source was refitted independently. Because these source/reference distributions are unpaired, the matrix was strongly regularised toward identity, neutral/clothing was fitted for chroma at its source luminance, and the LUT was fitted only at fixed black, skin-tone, and white anchors. LUT monotonicity was asserted numerically before export.

The 13 Aug founder pack documents the relevant treatment as pale mist-blue atmosphere, warm protected skin, slightly compressed denim/navy saturation, and preserved texture. Its files remain labelled review-only, so this report treats them as a founder-specific measurement supplement, not as evidence of human approval.

The nine allowed established `*_brandmatched*.webp` files contain products and backdrops but no people. Genuine skin pixels therefore cannot be isolated from those nine. Their textured neutral/cool pixels define the established brand neutral reference. The four already graded founder masters in the 13 Aug pack provide the only real founder-skin and founder-clothing pixels and are used as the supplemental semantic fit target. The excluded `maplemoon_heros73_brandmatched.webp` and `mm23_xmp_blue_hero_2400.webp` were not fitted or sampled.

Skin isolation used fixed face-measurement ellipses followed by alpha==255, YCbCr Cb 77..135 and Cr 133..180, R > 1.04 B, saturation >= 0.08, and value 35..252. Clothing/neutral used alpha==255, excluded the face ellipses, accepted low saturation <= 0.24 or cool hue 175..255 degrees with saturation <= 0.72, and luminance 8..248. For the established product references, a local RGB edge threshold >= 8 additionally excluded the smooth backdrop. All fit and source statistics use only alpha==255 pixels.

Black and white points are luminance P0.5 and P99.5, respectively. Luminance is Rec.709 sRGB code-value luminance (0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B).

One source profile exception was handled before fitting: `bio_dylan_701_masked.png` is tagged Display P3 and its RGB was colour-managed into sRGB. The other three sources are untagged and were treated as sRGB, matching the untagged established finals. Every delivered file embeds an sRGB ICC profile.
